audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].side read Skill/Skill/Skill/Veigar while content win[3..6] all read Hwei.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Hwei on all seven rows and matches the content layer exactly; win rate 52.58% over 1879 games. Every phases[N].why on those rows already describes Hwei winning.
audit.corrected: Four rows moved to Hwei as one atomic group so the chart stops arguing with its own captions.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text labels Event Horizon as (R) and tells you Veigar's level 6 adds no burst. Primordial Burst is not mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Event Horizon is E (20/18.5/17/15.5/14s, 725 range, stun only, no damage). Primordial Burst is R (120/90/60s, 650 range) and its damage increases based on the target's missing health — it is the single most dangerous thing in his kit and the reason the cage exists.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike rewritten around Primordial Burst scaling off missing health, and the same fact carried into enemyWin, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d.
sources: enemyKit R text, cd and range

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and content late tell you to rely on "(E stun, W fear)". spikes[0].text says Veigar farms "with W stacks in melee range". whys[0] calls his stacking "melee-reliant". wants.foe[0] says he stacks the passive off minion damage.
audit.why: Hwei's W form is Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights — the shield form; the crowd control including the fear is the E form. Dark Matter is a 950-range delayed drop, nothing about it is melee. Phenomenal Evil Power stacks from striking champions with spells or scoring takedowns; the permanent AP from farming comes from Baleful Strike (Q) kills, a different mechanic.
audit.corrected: Fear returned to the E form, the melee claims removed, and the stacking attributed to Baleful Strike kills and champion hits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lintFindings) and winCon promises a "fifteen-second gap".
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 falling to 14s at rank 5 — the gap is twenty seconds early, not fifteen. Baleful Strike reaches 4s at rank 5 and Primordial Burst 60s at rank 3.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, winCon, tradeGood and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d is tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d is tradeBad verbatim (lintFindings).
audit.why: Titles promise the cooldown gap and the half-HP mistake; the pasted bodies address neither.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the 20-second cage gap and to Primordial Burst's missing-health scaling, which is exactly why standing at half health is the mistake the title names.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags "Stack Phenomenal Evil Power" in wants.foe[0]. The name is right; what was wrong is the mechanic attached to it, which is corrected under point 4.
